 ORDER

This misc.appeal, under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, has been filed against the award dated 27.09.2021 passed by the Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur in MVCA No.2015/2018.

entities.text: Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. This appeal has been filed by the claimants for enhancement of compensation amount.

3. Since the factum of the death of deceased is not in dispute, therefore, it is suffice to mention here that on 02.03.2018 the deceased was going on his motorcycle and when he reached in front of Royal Tent House, Kripal Chowk, Jabalpur, he was dashed from behind by the offending car No.MP 20CF 0204, as a result he sustained injuries.
He remained hospitalized till 04.03.2018 where he died in the hospital.
4. The Claims Tribunal, after considering the documents produced by the appellants, has assessed that the monthly income of the deceased was Rs.7,500/-.
It was the case of the appellant that the monthly income of the deceased was Rs.12,000/-.

He was working as Carpenter with Shah Furnitures and Decorators and the Proprietor of Shah Furnitures has issued a certificate on his letter head that the deceased was working in his establishment as Carpenter for the last 8 years and he was paying monthly salary @7500/-.
It was the case of the appellants that apart from working in the Shah Furnitures, the deceased was also having other sources of income.

The Claims Tribunal has held that so far as the other sources of income is concerned, the appellant has failed to prove the same and accordingly has relied upon the certificate issued by the Proprietor of Shah Furnitures (Ex.P.24), according to which the deceased was being paid monthly salary of Rs.7500/-.
5.
Since the deceased was a bachelor, therefore, his personal expenses were taken as 50%.
There is no dispute that incorrect multiplier was applied.
Even the compensation awarded under the conventional head is in accordance with law.

6. No case is made out to hold that the deceased was having any income in addition to what was being paid by Monek Shah, the Proprietor of Shah Furnitures (P.W.3).
7.

As no case is made out for enhancement of award, accordingly the award dated 27.09.2021 passed by the Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur in MVCA No.2015/2018 is hereby affirmed.

entities.text: Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 8. The appeal fails and is hereby dismissed.
